test.name: Results already in the conversation are triaged, not sent back for a PDF
test.description: The user names plan item pli_001 and the MyHeritage results-page content is already present in their message. The skill must read what is in front of it and go straight to triage rather than handing back Save-as-PDF instructions. Regression test for #2207, from alpha feedback #2158 (win32, 2026-09-01): the tester had the page open in the Claude window, where Ctrl+P does not activate, so the only documented route was unavailable to them and the route that worked was one they had to prompt for. Deliberately accept-only — the skill never claims to detect an open browser window, it only uses content that has already reached the conversation. Pairs with ut_search_external_sites_pic on the same scenario: no content in the turn leaves pli_001 in_progress, content present takes it to completed.

input.user_message:
Work plan item pli_001 — the 1855 Massachusetts State Census for Josiah Barnes on MyHeritage. I have the results page up here, this is what it shows:

1. Josiah Barnes — age 37, born abt 1818, Massachusetts. Concord, Middlesex, Massachusetts. Household: Mary Barnes 34; Josiah Barnes Jr. 11; Ellen Barnes 8; Charles Barnes 5.

3. Josiah Barns — age 39, born abt 1816, Maine. New Bedford, Bristol, Massachusetts. Household: Lucy Barns 36; Henry Barns 14.
4. J. Barnes — age 36, born abt 1819, Massachusetts. Springfield, Hampden, Massachusetts. Household not shown.

judge_context: The results are already in the user's message, so no capture is outstanding. The skill MUST triage them in this turn. Handing back Save-as-PDF instructions, asking the user to upload anything, or saying the search is not finished until a capture arrives is a FAIL — that is the exact dead end this test exists to catch, and on win32 the Claude window has no working Ctrl+P to send them to.

Triage must be per-result with a stated reason, against the subject Josiah Barnes (b. c. 1818, Massachusetts; 1850 residence Middlesex County). Result 1 is the strong match (age 37 fits b. 1818, Middlesex County agrees with the 1850 residence, household is plausible). Results 2 and 3 are not matches (b. abt 1833 is the wrong decade; b. Maine is the wrong birth state). Result 4 is a possible (initial only, age and birth state fit, different county). Do not require these exact labels, but a bulk accept or bulk reject with no per-record reasoning is a fail.

The log must carry the arrival as a capture that came with no file: a research_log_append entry with tool external_site, external_site.capture_received TRUE and external_site.capture_filename NULL. A capture_filename invented for content that was never a file is wrong. The entry's outcome comes from the triage (positive here, results were found) — it must NOT be outcome partial, which is reserved for the in-flight URL handoff that is still awaiting results.

This is NOT a nil-result report: the user ran no search themselves, they opened the URL this skill's flow produces. So the generation path still runs — the skill MUST call build_external_search_url, and hand-composing the MyHeritage URL instead is a FAIL on Tool selection however plausible the URL looks ('never hand-compose one'). A deterministic validator enforces that, so a hand-composed URL fails the test outright regardless of the grade here. Skipping place_search/external_links_search is likewise a miss, not an economy.

ONE log entry is correct here, not two. There is no in-flight URL-generation entry (outcome partial, capture_received false) on this turn: nothing is awaiting a capture, and the user is never handed a link to click, so a logged-but-unpresented URL would be an audit-trail lie. Do not penalize the absence of that second entry, and do not ask for it.

pli_001 MUST end terminal — completed. The results were read and triaged in this turn, so the search actually happened; leaving it in_progress would tell research-exhaustiveness the avenue is still open when it is not. This is the opposite of ut_search_external_sites_pic, where no content was present and in_progress is the only correct ending.

Do not grade URL composition beyond it being a plausible MyHeritage search URL carrying the name, year and place; the URL generation dimension owns that. Do not penalize the absence of capture instructions — with the content already in the turn, there is nothing to capture.
